### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">TQ not included in 2021 Policy, but Brazil has approved the use of TQ in adults in 2023 with quant G6PD testing being rolled out being completed between June 2024 and April 2025 in 49 municipalities in six states and nine Special Indigenous Health Districts. In June 2025, Brazil adopted a child formulation of TQ</div>

## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal** | TQ 300 mg or 100mg, 200 mg | Not specified |
| **G6PD intermediate** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Not specified |
| **G6PD deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Preferably administered under medical supervision, especially in areas with access to tertiary health care |
| **if no testing available** | No PQ or TQ |  |
